prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair the menu bar for a Mac database editor. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. App places all commands in a custom in-window hamburger menu, replaces standard Undo with Publish and gives Save a changing shortcut. Window commands operate on a hidden document instead of the active one.
